# Opportunities

We regularly have openings for students and collaborators to join our projects.
Below are the current opportunities — each card lists what the project is about and
who we are looking for. Interested? [Get in touch](contact.qmd).

### AI in Crisis Chat Service

Evaluation of an AI tool that supports crisis chat workers to respond to service users.

<ul class="opp-reqs">
  <li><span class="check">✔</span> Research and Admin</li>
  <li><span class="check">✔</span> NUS Students</li>
  <li><span class="check">✔</span> 2–3 hours a week for a semester</li>
</ul>
:::

::: {.opp-card}
[Recruiting]{.opp-status}

### What Works in Text-Based Engagement in Chat Services?

We want to understand the key skills and techniques that are central to effective text-based chat services.

<ul class="opp-reqs">
  <li><span class="check">✔</span> Qualitative &amp; quantitative text analysis, data annotation, writing</li>
  <li><span class="check">✔</span> Researchers, NUS Students, Graduate Students &amp; Practitioners</li>
  <li><span class="check">✔</span> 2–3 hours a week</li>
</ul>
:::

::: {.opp-card}
[Recruiting]{.opp-status}

### AI-Avatar Role-Playing Simulation for Social Work, Nursing, and Medical Students

We are evaluating the impact of this tool on students and conducting user experience research.

<ul class="opp-reqs">
  <li><span class="check">✔</span> Participants to test our tool; qualitative interviewing, data annotation &amp; quantitative analysis</li>
  <li><span class="check">✔</span> Researchers, NUS Students &amp; Graduate Students</li>
  <li><span class="check">✔</span> 2–3 hours a week</li>
</ul>
:::
